pages.text: An Elixirspindle is an Arcane Gem formed from a purple-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in a pampel cut.$(br2)When held, you can use potions, splash potions, and lingering potions without consuming them at the cost of one point of charge. Additionally, if you use a potion you do not need to drink it and instead benefit from its effects immediately.
Elixirspindles can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
